title: Calibration methods compared: identity, Platt, isotonic, beta
why: Probabilistic forecasts are only useful if they are calibrated; production teams monitor and re-calibrate them (docs/SOURCES.md, lab sources).
notes: The `ml` backtest probabilities of run power-2025-11-01-2026-10-31-20261113T0954, re-calibrated day by day on earlier days only (batch days 2026-03-01 to 2026-10-31, 120 warm-up days, weekly refit).
Identity is the power champion as it is (it is already Platt-calibrated inside its own training).
limits: A backtest, not live: one market, one year, six strongly correlated questions a day.
Re-calibrating already calibrated probabilities can only add noise unless the model drifted; no live change follows from this study (rule I8).
